rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:FlowPath
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: any non-atomic/non-elementary kind of HY_FlowPath comprised of a contiguous set of atomic/elementary flowpaths

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: geo:hasGeometry
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A spatial representation for a given Feature.

rdf:Description.dcterms:description: This ontology supports querying the SAWGraph Knowledge Graph. It adapts and extends concepts from HY_Features, HyFO, and GWML2
rdf:Description.dcterms:title: SAWGraph's hydrology (water) ontology - an adaptation and extension of concepts from HY_Features, HyFO, and GWML2
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: SAWGraph's hydrology (water) ontology - an adaptation and extension of concepts from HY_Features, HyFO, and GWML2
hyf:HY_WaterBody
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A waterbody is part of the hydrographic network and is either standing in a depression or flowing in a channel, which are parts of the channel network

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_Canal
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a body of surface water, participating in a hydrographic network, that is special due to its artificial origin (man-made)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: wbd:containingHUC
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates a flowline catchment to any WBD drainage basin it lies within

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: geo:Geometry
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A coherent set of direct positions in space. The positions are held within a Spatial Reference System (SRS).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_Impoundment
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a body of surface water, participating in a hydrographic network, seen as being special due to being formed by collecting water, for example in the case of a dam

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: geo:SpatialObject
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Anything spatial (being or having a shape, position or an extent).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:GW_HydrogeoUnit
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Any soil or rock unit or zone that by virtue of its hydraulic properties has a distinct influence on the storage or movement of groundwater (after ANS, 1980)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_River
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a body of surface water, participating in a hydrographic network, which is special due to its property to permanently or temporarily flow

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_CatchmentDivide
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: One-dimensional (linear) feature that is a hydrology-specific realization of the holistic catchment

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:gwMonitoringHost
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies the feature hosting the site [GW_MonitoringSite], e.g., a well, spring, lake or stream

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_FlowPath
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: realizes a catchment specifically as a path connecting the inflow and outflow of the catchment it realizes

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: geo:defaultGeometry
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The default Geometry to be used in spatial calculations. It is usually the most detailed Geometry.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:downstreamFlowPathTC
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: The transitive closure of the nhdplusv2:downstreamFlowPath object property

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:HydroRockBody
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a hybrid physical object, such as aquifer, well, or lake, that consists partly of a rock body (a container), empty spaces therein (voids), and a water body inside the space

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:FlowLine
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: any atomic/elementary kind of HY_FlowPath within a given framework/context (for example, a single NHDFlowline instance)
area of associated catchment may be zero (per hydrologic fabric logic model)
can be part of at most one mainstem

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:partOfFlowPath
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Connects an elementary flowpath (e.g., NHDFlowline) to any non-elementary flowpath it is a part of

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:associatedCatchmentArea
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies the one and only one catchment area that is associated with a particular flowpath

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasReachCode
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates an NHDPlusV2 feature to its ReachCode

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:divergence
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Indicates if a nhdplusv2:FlowLine is the main-path or a minor-path of a divergence (no triple if no divergence)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_Lake
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a body of surface water, participating in a hydrographic network, made special due to its considerable size

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:FlowPathLength
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: The length of a flowpath

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:downstreamFlowPath
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies another flowpath immediately downstream, allowing network navigation without knowing an inflow or outflow of the catchment realized by the flowpath

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:realizedCatchment
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies the one and only one catchment that is realized by a particular feature

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:gwAquiferSystem
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates an aquifer system part, which can be another system, aquifer or confining bed, with its aquifer system

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:downstreamWaterBody
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies another waterbody immediately downstream, allowing network navigation without knowing an inflow or outflow of the catchment realized by the waterbody

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:gwAquiferSystemPart
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates an aquifer system with its parts, which can be other systems, aquifers or confining beds

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:downstreamWaterBodyTC
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: The transitive closure of the nhdplusv2:downstreamWaterBody object property

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:GW_AquiferSystem
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A body of permeable and poorly permeable material that functions regionally as a water-yielding unit; it comprises two or more permeable beds separated at least locally by confining beds that impede groundwater movement but do not greatly affect the regional hydraulic continuity of the system; includes both saturated and unsaturated parts of permeable material (after ASCE, 1987)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: geo:Feature
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A discrete spatial phenomenon in a universe of discourse.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:GW_AquiferUnit
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Denotes aquifer-related hydrogeological units: aquifer systems, aquifers, or confining beds

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: wbd:primaryFlowPath
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates a drainage basin (area) to the primary mainstem flowing through it

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:upstreamFlowPath
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies another flowpath immediately upstream, allowing network navigation without knowing an inflow or outflow of the catchment realized by the flowpath

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:upstreamWaterBody
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies another waterbody immediately upstream, allowing network navigation without knowing an inflow or outflow of the catchment realized by the waterbody

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_DendriticCatchment
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a catchment which is determined by a single common downstream catchment

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:FlowLineCatchment
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: The catchment polygon for a nhdplusv2:FlowLine

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:AquiferWaterFeature
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: An aquifer water feature including water, container, and void

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasFlowPathLength
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates any flowpath to its length, represented as, for example, a qudt:Quantity object

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:SurfaceWaterFeature
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A complete surface water feature including water, container, and void (for example: lake, river, marsh, et al.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:WaterFeature
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A complete water feature including water, container, and void; includes surface and subsurface water features

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:GW_Aquifer
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A body of earth material that contains / potentially contains / potentially contained sufficient saturated permeable material to yield significant quantities of water to wells and springs (after Lohman, 1972)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:partOfMainStem
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Connects an elementary flowpath (e.g., NHDFlowline) to its main stem

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:gwWellUnit
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies the aquifers or confining beds intersecting the well

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: wbd:DrainageBasin
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A HUC12 watershed (drainage area) from the WBD

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_HydroFeature
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a basic feature to reflect the properties that all hydrologic features have

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: wbd:contributingDrainageBasin
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates a mainstem to the drainage basin (area) it drains

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_CatchmentArea
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Two-dimensional (areal) hydrology-specific realization of the holistic catchment

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasFTYPE
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates an NHDPlusV2 feature to its FTYPE (see also nhdplusv2:hasFCODE)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasLevelPathId
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: The level path id of a flowline is the hydrologic sequence number of the most downstream flowline feature in the level path and is used to connect flowlines to their corresponding main stem

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasCOMID
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates an NHDPlusV2 feature to its COMID

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasSlope
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: The numeric average slope of a flowline

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasMainStemId
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates a nhdplusv2:MainStem feature to its unique identifier

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:hasFCODE
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates an NHDPlusV2 feature to its FCODE (see also nhdplusv2:hasFTYPE)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_Lagoon
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a body of surface water, participating in a hydrographic network, which is special due to its shallow depth and interaction with the open sea

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:partOfWaterBody
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Connects an elementary flowpath to a waterbody it lies within

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:MainStem
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a named river or similar feature, represented from head to outlet (a composition of elemenatry flowpaths (flowlines) per hydrologic fabric logic model)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_CatchmentRealization
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: based on the idea that there are multiple hydrology-specific perspectives of the holistic catchment concept that are used to describe a catchment as a unit of study shared across sub-domains and studies

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:WaterWell
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A water well, with focus on the hole/shaft itself (see gwml2:GW_Well)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:WaterFeatureRepresentation
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A representation of a water feature (for example, a line or polygon)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:GW_Well
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A shaft or hole sunk, dug or drilled into the Earth to observe, extract or inject water (after IGH1397)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:SubsurfaceWaterFeature
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: A complete subsurface water feature including water, container, and void (for example, aquifer, well, et al.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_Catchment
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: captures the union of catchment and hydro nexus, and the multiple realizations of the holistic catchment concept

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:isRepresentedByWFR
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Relates a water feature to a representation of that water feature

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nhdplusv2:containsFlowLine
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Connects a flowline catchment with its flowline(s)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyfo:tapsAquifer
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Identifies the aquifer a well taps

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gwml2:GW_MonitoringSite
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: Site of observation related to groundwater

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hyf:HY_Estuary
rdf:Description.dcterms:description: a body of surface water, participating in a hydrographic network, made special due to branching and its interaction with the open sea
